## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

<sub>[price source](https://replicate.com/wan-video/wan-2.1-1.3b): USD per second of 480p video, derived from Replicate's price of $0.20 per output video for wan-video/wan-2.1-1.3b, whose page says it generates 5s 480p videos (÷ 5 = $0.04). Product: Replicate model API. API model: wan-video/wan-2.1-1.3b. Settings: resolution=480p (only option), frame\_num=81 (default; 16 fps playback). Price basis: published per-output-video rate ÷ the 5-second duration Replicate states; shorter frame\_num settings cost the same per video. Currency: USD. Not an Alibaba direct tariff. Replicate official model page, observed 2026-09-26.</sub>

```sh
# fp16 + umt5 q8_0 (sd.cpp)
sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/wan2.1_t2v_1.3B_fp16.safetensors --vae models/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors --t5xxl models/umt5-xxl-encoder-Q8_0.gguf -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -n "色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走" -W 832 -H 480 --diffusion-fa --video-frames 33 --flow-shift 3.0
# fp16 + umt5 q4_k_m (sd.cpp)
sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/wan2.1_t2v_1.3B_fp16.safetensors --vae models/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors --t5xxl models/umt5-xxl-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -n "色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走" -W 832 -H 480 --diffusion-fa --video-frames 33 --flow-shift 3.0
```
